headline: B200 index edges up +1% as neocloud and marketplace segments climb; H200 marketplace rises despite flat index.
bullets: B200's market index rose +1% to $8.60 over 7 days, driven by marketplace (+8%) and neocloud (+6%) segments while the hyperscaler median held at $14.12 (+0%).
H200's index was flat at $5.40, but its marketplace median rose +6% to $4.33; A100 80GB SXM likewise showed a flat $2.70 index with marketplace up +6% to $1.32.
L40S marketplace prices slipped -3% to $0.76, with Vast.ai cheapest at $0.73, while its $1.50 index was unchanged.
H100 PCIe offers the best price-performance of the 11 tracked GPUs at $3.60 per PFLOP-hour, narrowly ahead of MI300X at $3.62.
H100 NVL carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +184%, versus +140% for H100 SXM, whose hyperscaler median of $10.68 compares with a $4.45 neocloud median.
watch: Whether B200 neocloud (+6%) and marketplace (+8%) gains spread to the hyperscaler segment, which held at +0% this week.
